snippet.title: ESSOMENIC | Official Trailer | Summer Game Fest 2026
snippet.description:
ESSOMENIC
You are the surgeon navigating patients' memories via crude, retro machinery, under the command of a strange, occult organization. Keep your patients alive long enough to uncover your exact role in this surreal mess of an operation.
